subject: CHEMISTRY
purpose: Governed mapping from internal role/state identifiers to the warm, plain-English titles a Grade-9 learner actually reads. Internal identifiers are NOT renamed: schema fields, falsifier names and JSON enum values keep using them, and every test and engine keeps matching on them. What changes is that no renderer may print an internal role verbatim on a learner surface — it must resolve the role through this registry or fail closed.

known_learner_copy_debt: The word 'representation' still appears inside upstream-authored body copy that comes from the C-G problem-authoring templates, the promoted-PCK registry and the C-H primitive descriptions. It is barred from headings by forbidden_heading_phrases but is not yet barred everywhere, because rewriting that copy is a subject-authoring change rather than a renderer change. It is queued for the next authoring-copy pass and is deliberately NOT listed in forbidden_anywhere_phrases so this registry does not claim a cleanliness it has not got.

Chemistry-specific role titles beyond this table (for example a future 'lab safety note' role) must be added here before a renderer may print them; an unmapped role fails closed with LEARNER_TITLE_MISSING_FOR_ROLE rather than falling back to the internal identifier.

body_text_substitution_policy: Applied to learner-facing body copy before it is drawn. These exist because some upstream strings are written at the producer rather than at the learner; each one is a wording change only, and none changes a chemical claim. They are governed here rather than hard-coded in the renderer so they can be reviewed as learner copy.
